crude_argument.identity: size = Σ(|S|-1) - excess + #zero_merge  (each set has exactly |S|-1 merges: union-find gives <=, the output forces >=)
crude_argument.excess_bound: for a crossing pair (a,b), merges of S_a shared with S_b join two classes each holding an element of P_ab = S_a ∩ (S_b ∪ T_b); |P_ab| <= 1 + |S_a ∩ T_b|, so shared merges <= |S_a ∩ T_b|; hence excess <= Σ crossing incidences
crude_argument.h_cost: each crossing element p ∈ S_a ∩ T_b lies on a minterm of h avoiding S_b (minimality of T_b), so h reads x_p; h needs >= (#crossing elements - 1) gates
crude_argument.gap: gates inside h's subcircuit can themselves be merges (e.g. h = x1 ∨ x2 with {1,2} inside an easy set), so they are not automatically zero-merge
